text.p: -- Oppenheimer & Co analyst Jose Linares said he reduced his fiscal year 1996 and 1997 earnings per ADR estimates for Telecom Argentina SA.
-- He said he lowered his FY96 view to $2.81 from $2.90 and his FY97 view to $3.40 from $3.60.
-- He said he maintained his buy rating on the stock.
-- The change was made on Monday.

-- "Congress approved the increase in the corporate income tax rate in late September, applicable for all fiscal years closing after September 27, 1996," Linares said in a reserach note. "The change ... will have a large impact on Telecom's fourth quarter earnings since the company must provision not only for the current quarter but for the previous three quarters as well."
-- Shares were up 3/8 at 42-3/8 at midday Tuesday.
